title: motor
explanation:
### Description

Read BYU motor parts with texture coordinates and implicit texture mapping.

**dataset → input → dataset → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBYUReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBYUReader.html) — byu reader.
- [vtkCamera](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCamera.html) — camera.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkImplicitTextureCoords](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImplicitTextureCoords.html) — implicit texture coords.
- [vtkNamedColors](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkNamedColors.html) — named colors.
- [vtkPlanes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlanes.html) — planes.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyDataNormals](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataNormals.html) — computes surface normals for smooth shading.
- [vtkStructuredPointsReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStructuredPointsReader.html) — structured points reader.
- [vtkTexture](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexture.html) — applies a texture image to geometry.
- [vtkTriangleFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriangleFilter.html) — converts polygons into triangles.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
